mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <30% of instances during FEDFUNDS declines, or the 20d return is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a t-test against a baseline period of FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 13.3% by more than 0.3 percentage points within three months signals labor market tightening, raising inflation expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during UNRATE rises exceeding the threshold, or the return is negative despite the trigger occurring.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in both GDPC1 (total chained 2017 dollars) and RSAFS (millions of dollars) signal robust demand-side growth, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and RSAFS increase in the same month
failure_condition: 60d returns fail to be positive in >50% of instances when both proxies rise, or the returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) against a baseline period of dual demand growth.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising FEDFUNDS rates compress equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns during a monetary tightening cycle, contradicting the expected negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS ( monthly thousands of persons employed ) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods of rising PAYEMS, or the returns are negative despite the labor market strengthening.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the CPIAUCSL index (CPI) by over 5% in a single month signals accelerating inflation, prompting central bank rate hikes that compress equity returns, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are positive during periods of CPIAUCSL spikes exceeding the threshold, or the returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) against a baseline of moderate inflation.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in both GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) indicate robust economic growth, expanding market demand and production capacity, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase in the same month
failure_condition: 60d returns fail to be positive in >60% of instances when both proxies rise, or the returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) against a baseline of dual growth periods.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a drop in UNRATE below 10% signals improving labor market conditions without yet reaching full strength, prompting optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: in post-shock recovery regime and UNRATE <10%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns during a post-shock recovery regime when UNRATE falls below 10%, contradicting the expected positive returns.
